title: The Reclaimer
description: A Mod That Adds a Helpful Crafting Recipe That If You Make A Extra Tool You Can Get You Items Back!!
body:
A mod that if you make a extra tool or even crafting table you can get your items back! So if you make a extra Diamond Picaxe you can put it in a crafting table and get 3 diamonds back! So if your that type of person that makes diamond hoes you can get your items back with this mod!

**BUG REPORTS** - https://forms.office.com/r/LMDJnZ7HYT
